summary: Iteration 19 — Analytics reset + clickable drill-down tiles. Backend pytest 25/25 passed. Frontend E2E: login + analytics tab + tile clicks (visitors/role-customer/gmv) + reset confirm + regression tabs all working. Zero JS console errors during full flow. Reset → toast 'Analytics reset. 12 old pageviews cleared.' shown. Cutoff display 'tracking since Jun 25, 07:34 PM' rendered as expected.
action_items: (Minor / docs only) Review request says sign-in path is /sign-in, but App.js routes /signin (no hyphen). All pageviews to /sign-in get logged but render nothing — consider adding a /sign-in alias or correcting future review requests.

(Cosmetic) <Link to={r.path}> inside the top_paths drill-down dialog will try to navigate within the SPA. If r.path is an external URL or unknown route, it may surprise the operator. Consider <a href=...> with target=_blank instead — currently it has target=_blank but uses react-router Link, which ignores target=_blank for internal navigation. Low priority.
critical_code_review_comments: analytics.py:474 — window_start = max(cutoff_global, (now-delta).isoformat()) when delta is None uses cutoff_global directly for 'all' range, which is correct (and respects the reset cutoff).

analytics.py:533 — active_statuses for jobs includes 'deposit_paid', but jobs never use that status (it's an order status). Harmless but the list is slightly mixed. Consider splitting active_jobs vs active_orders status sets.
analytics.py details endpoint applies cutoff_global for signups via `created_at >= window_start` where window_start ≥ cutoff_global, so the reset filter is implicitly enforced. Good.
Analytics.jsx ~700 lines — could be split into 3 files (Tile/Dialog, ResetButton, page) for readability. Not blocking.
Analytics.jsx top_paths dialog uses react-router <Link to={r.path}> with target=_blank — react-router intercepts and ignores target. Should be plain <a>.

Backend uses `await db.pageviews.delete_many({})` on reset which doesn't honor cutoff_at — by design (full wipe), but document that pageviews are permanently lost on reset (not just hidden by cutoff).
